g.text: Fixed seeds 42/43/44; same 90 scored days; no seed or checkpoint selection.
One predeclared station only. Descriptive conditional results, not city-wide estimates or significance tests.
Seasonal Naive is deterministic; its repeated seed values are not independent runs of different stations.
